Name: Leah New Hair
Author: CoffeeBuns
Description:
I didn't like Leah's hair so I redid it! I feel like her hair looks fuller in the sprite so that was kind of what I was going for. And, I mean, she's an artist living in the woods it seemed like her hair could stand to be a bit messier. I also just wasn't a fan of the previous texture.

Anyway I don't know if other people will like it but I think it's cute. :)
The first picture is the new hair, the second picture is the normal hair for comparison.

Feel free to edit or use it. You can reupload a changed version but please credit and link back to me.

Installation:
(default) Go to [size=2]C:\Program Files\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits
Back up the original "Leah.xnb" file
Replace it with the new (unzipped) "Leah.xnb" file [/size]
